Exactly two independent subjects: A is an adult female approximately thirty years old, fair skin, medium build, wet dark brown long hair draped over her shoulders, wearing a dark grey long-sleeve pajama top and dark trousers, unarmed. She stands before the sink facing the mirror, shoulders stiff with terror, hands braced on the sink rim, wide-eyed, breathing rapidly. B is the same giant, slender humanoid monster: initially disguised as A's reflection in the mirror—sharing an identical face, wet hair, and pajamas, but smiling while A is not, with the mouth corners barely wider than normal and eyes slightly more open, expression quiet, stiff, and unnatural, not a cartoonish grin. Once peeled open, the interior reveals a deformed elongated face of interwoven dark red and fleshy-pink muscle bundles, sunken nasal cavities, staring round eyes, fine ivory teeth, and an abnormally stretched oral cavity with multiple rows of teeth aligned longitudinally down the oral cavity and deep into the lower jaw; the mouth is a tall, narrow vertical slit whose height greatly exceeds its width when open, not a round hole or skull-like; the head, neck, and torso maintain continuous anatomical structure, not several distinct heads. The entire body consists of sculpted reddish-brown and fleshy-pink biological tissue with defined contours across shoulder blades, spine, ribs, elongated arms, and thighs, with restrained wet highlights, not a human painted red. Limbs are extremely long, hands thick with slender fingers, standard two arms and two legs; no armor, weapons, horns, wings, or visible genitalia. When crawling out of the mirror and crouching, it remains significantly taller than A, forced to bend knees and hips and lower its back under the low ceiling; scale disparity is communicated through the woman, sink, candle, and mirror together. The humanoid reflection and subsequent red behemoth represent the continuous state of B shedding its disguise, with no third subject added. 0.00–0.60s: Begin directly with a tight frontal close-up of the mirror reflection, face filling the frame from forehead to chin with mirror oxidation spots faintly visible at the borders; wet hair clings to the face, illuminated from below by candlelight, background blurred. translations.en: The humanoid face in the mirror, monster, woman, hands, facial close-ups, and bathroom all adopt the same distinct AAA computer-generated fantasy game CG aesthetic; the woman must also possess the sculpted facial volumes, strand-bundled hair, and unified material shading of a polished game character, preventing her from looking like a live-action actor while only the monster is CG. Not live-action footage, cosplay, standard gameplay, 2D animation, or cel-shaded. The image natively fills the entire widescreen; no text, subtitles, titles, logos, or watermarks throughout. Environment: late night in an old, cramped bathroom with low ceilings, yellowed and cracked white square tiled walls, and dark weathered floor tiles; an old rectangular mirror hangs on the wall above the sink, its edges marked by black oxidation spots; below the mirror is a white ceramic sink and a narrow countertop. The only noticeable practical light source is a white candle placed on the right side of the sink counter, its flame flickering continuously, casting warm amber light from below onto the subjects and throwing thick but readable elongated shadows; a light mist lingers in the air after a bath. Maintain desaturated brown, dark gold, and monster reddish-brown palette without cold blue neon or modern lighting. Exactly two independent subjects: A is an adult female approximately thirty years old, fair skin, medium build, wet dark brown long hair draped over her shoulders, wearing a dark grey long-sleeve pajama top and dark trousers, unarmed. She stands before the sink facing the mirror, shoulders stiff with terror, hands braced on the sink rim, wide-eyed, breathing rapidly. B is the same giant, slender humanoid monster: initially disguised as A's reflection in the mirror—sharing an identical face, wet hair, and pajamas, but smiling while A is not, with the mouth corners barely wider than normal and eyes slightly more open, expression quiet, stiff, and unnatural, not a cartoonish grin. Once peeled open, the interior reveals a deformed elongated face of interwoven dark red and fleshy-pink muscle bundles, sunken nasal cavities, staring round eyes, fine ivory teeth, and an abnormally stretched oral cavity with multiple rows of teeth aligned longitudinally down the oral cavity and deep into the lower jaw; the mouth is a tall, narrow vertical slit whose height greatly exceeds its width when open, not a round hole or skull-like; the head, neck, and torso maintain continuous anatomical structure, not several distinct heads. The entire body consists of sculpted reddish-brown and fleshy-pink biological tissue with defined contours across shoulder blades, spine, ribs, elongated arms, and thighs, with restrained wet highlights, not a human painted red. Limbs are extremely long, hands thick with slender fingers, standard two arms and two legs; no armor, weapons, horns, wings, or visible genitalia. When crawling out of the mirror and crouching, it remains significantly taller than A, forced to bend knees and hips and lower its back under the low ceiling; scale disparity is communicated through the woman, sink, candle, and mirror together. The humanoid reflection and subsequent red behemoth represent the continuous state of B shedding its disguise, with no third subject added. 0.00–0.60s: Begin directly with a tight frontal close-up of the mirror reflection, face filling the frame from forehead to chin with mirror oxidation spots faintly visible at the borders; wet hair clings to the face, illuminated from below by candlelight, background blurred. Reflection stares straight into the camera with that stiff, unnervingly subtle smile; camera nearly static with a minimal slow push-in, without first establishing an empty bathroom. 0.60–3.10s: Retain the full-frame frontal close-up; one hand of the reflection grasps the top hairline while the other pinches the lower edge of the chin; hands only grip the perimeter, never obscuring the central face, eyes, or mouth. Upper hand pulls upward, lower hand pulls downward, peeling the humanoid face open along a straight vertical midline. Fingers gain purchase, outer layer tightens, then pale skin splits down the center revealing the continuous red monster face beneath; fine moist connective fibers stretch across the fissure. Fingers consistently hold the same outer layer without introducing a separate face or flashing into a monster. Movement is slow, continuous, showing tensile resistance; camera does not cut away from the reveal. 3.10–4.90s: Continue the close-up; the peeled halves remain attached at the sides of the head without falling off, each human eye still open and staring directly into the camera; the elongated red monster face pushes forward between them into full view, displaying both remaining human eyes alongside the monster face. It parts the tall, narrow vertical slit revealing rows of fine teeth and stretched jaw anatomy, uttering a low, non-verbal hiss; moist fibers tauten and slacken between the face halves and red flesh. Maintain visceral body-horror reveal without fire, lightning, transformation beams, or duplicated heads. 4.90–7.20s: Hard cut to a frontal close-up of woman A from the mirror's perspective at a slightly low angle. She freezes at the sink, eyes wide, brow furrowed, mouth slightly parted in terror, chin trembling, head pulling back slightly; wet hair and pajama collar sharp, one side lit by candlelight while the other falls into shadow. Continuous breathing and micro-reactions without speaking. 7.20–10.90s: Maintaining A's framing, two massive reddish-brown monster hands reach out from the mirror into frame: the mirror surface ripples and yields like liquid black mercury as arms push through. One hand presses onto her forehead and hairline while the other cradles her jaw, long fingers depressing the lower lip. Clear contact between palms, forehead, and jaw is established before opposing force gradually forces her head backward and mouth open wider. Her eyes remain locked on the creature in the mirror, throat straining, hands gripping the sink rim tightly; contact remains clear without covering her eyes or clipping through cheeks. Her face remains identical, only opening wider under supernatural pressure without mutating. 10.90–13.40s: Hard cut to a low-angle side wide shot establishing bathroom geometry: A stands at the left before the sink, head forced back; mirror and sink on the right wall. B has crawled more than halfway out of the undulating liquid mirror: long arms stretch left holding her forehead and jaw; torso hunched over the sink, one long leg stepping out with foot planted on the counter rim, other leg trailing in the rippling glass, knees bent and back arched under the low ceiling. Candle sits secure on the counter's right beside the monster's foot. B tilts head back, opening the narrow vertical slit to maximum revealing multiple tooth tiers, releasing a raspy, piercing non-verbal screech vibrating through throat and chest, making the candle flame flutter violently. 13.40–17.00s: Continuing the side wide shot, B keeps mouth agape after the screech, lowering head and neck toward the front-left, aligning its elongated face toward A's unnaturally opened mouth; the stabilizing hand on her forehead and supporting hand on her jaw sustain the posture as the monster's head begins continuous descent into her mouth opening. A remains braced at the sink, torso arched back, hands gripping the edge, neck taut. B's head and neck make contact and gradually enter, keeping massive back and hindquarters outside; does not engulf A into the monster's mouth, no inverted orientation, no transparent mesh clipping. 17.00–20.00s: Persisting wide shot, B's shoulders push forward-left, neck and head increasingly obscured within A's oral cavity, massive arched back shifting weight as the second leg steps out onto the counter, mirror surface behind settling back to calm reflection of the dim room. Both hands firmly hold forehead and jaw without extraneous limbs; A trembles with weakening knees but remains upright, pajamas creasing under tension. Candle remains standing, flame wavering, shadows of creature and woman shifting slowly against the tiles. Ends at 20 seconds amidst ongoing intrusion with bulk and legs still outside, without concluding full penetration, escape, transformation, or death. Rhythm & Cinematography: Slow-burn supernatural horror reveal without devolving into chase or melee. Preserves shot progression: reflection close-up peel — woman's reaction close-up — hands emerging to manipulate jaw — side wide shot showing massive scale crawling out, screeching, and descending. Driven by continuous deformation and reaction, settling into a sustained wide shot for full spatial dynamics; avoids orbit shots, abrupt zooms, unrelated reaction cutaways, or jumpscare black frames. Slowness derives from calculated force and approach, without artificial ultra-slow motion, speed ramping, or freezes. Consistent warm amber grade, candle lighting direction, and spatial continuity. Continuity: Exactly two subjects; A remains adult female, wet brown hair, dark grey pajamas at the same sink; B has two arms and two legs, with the peeled reflection face identical in material and anatomy to the emerged giant body. Mirror remains unbroken without glass shards. Intact anatomy throughout, clear hand placement, entry trajectory strictly monster head into woman's mouth. Emphasizes bio-mechanical forms, dread reactions, and progressive uncanny action without gore splatters, flying viscera, or dismemberment. Strictly prohibits background music: no score, soundtrack, melodic themes, rhythmic percussion, choir, songs, musical drones, or tonal ambience at any point. Only synchronized diegetic audio native to the physical scene: slow sink drip, faint candle crackle, subtle tile resonance, fabric friction, woman's breath and strained gasps, monster's low breathing, wet tearing sound of parting tissue, low liquid resonance of distorted mirror, skin contact sounds, the raspy piercing screech from 10.90–13.40s, and deep creaks of strained joints. No dialogue, voiceover, intelligible speech, or subtitles; no musical cues or rhythmic pulses filling silence. Any presence of background music fails evaluation. music=0; no_music=1; strict_no_music=1; audio=diegetic_only; Native full-bleed frame without letterboxing, rounded corners, text, subtitles, titles, logos, UI, or watermarks.
